name: spec-driven
description: Stack-agnostic spec-driven development workflow (specify, then plan, implement; verify is planned). Available now: the spec-creator agent and /spec-driven:specify, which interview first and then write a behaviour spec (what, never how) with EARS acceptance criteria, module interactions, NFRs and untrusted-input rules; and the planner agent and /spec-driven:plan, which review the requirements and then write an implementation plan (contracts, work units with disjoint ownership per wave, skills, checks, traceability to the spec). Each writes only Markdown in its own folder (hook-enforced). And the implementer agent and /spec-driven:implement, which build an approved plan wave by wave (one implementer per unit, a check and a commit per wave, a spec-coverage check at the end; never a push or a pull request), with a Bash guard that limits the implementer to read-only git and the project's checkCommand.
